items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: and uh not Merritt but Henny Brunus played trombone for a while

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the people in it?

Well, they had, uh, Wingy on Trumpet. They had, uh, Pee Wee Russell. 

on clarinet they had a fella by the name of Humphreys playing drums and a kid from Baton Rouge I can't think of his name now he played saxophone little short young fella played saxophone we had a pretty nice band Wingy did you worked other places with Wingy too I guess yeah I worked in for luck he was winging at the Buena Vista hotel in the White House hotel and who did he have there at the Buena Vista we had uh Mike Ryan on drums we had uh Bob Sackerman on saxophone I don't know if you know Sackerman no I don't…
